name: aspi-budget-week
caption:
Share market up 4.3% in Budget week 📈

The CSE rose strongly in the four trading days before the 2027 Budget. The ASPI went up 917.75 points (4.32%), from 21,239.65 on 6 November to 22,157.40 on 12 November. The S&P SL20 rose 5.30% to 6,365.57.

Turnover was Rs 19.09 billion in four days, about Rs 4.77 billion a day. That is higher than this year's daily average of Rs 3.44 billion.

Source: Colombo Stock Exchange, The Morning, https://www.themorning.lk/articles/BbS1iantDQLRFTPmHwBk

name: cess-cut-795
caption:
Import CESS cut on 795 items from April 2027 🚢

Under Budget 2027, the CESS import tax will be cut on 795 items from 1 April 2027. 499 of them will become fully CESS free, including many building materials, machinery parts and raw materials.

Some examples: Portland cement CESS falls from Rs 7 to Rs 5.25 per kg, and paint from Rs 150 to Rs 112.50 per kg. Rice, crude palm oil, roofing tiles and electrical cables will become CESS free.

Lower import taxes can reduce costs for factories and builders.

Source: Daily FT, https://www.ft.lk/front-page/CESS-cut-on-795-import-lines-from-April-2027/44-800095

name: tourism-income-oct
caption:
Tourism income up for the third month in a row 🌴

Sri Lanka earned US$192.7 million from tourism in October 2026. That is 3.5% more than October last year, and the third monthly rise in a row. Tourist arrivals in October were up 2.1%.

From January to October, tourism income was US$2.44 billion, still 8.3% lower than the same period last year.

Source: Central Bank of Sri Lanka, SLTDA data, via EconomyNext, https://economynext.com/sri-lankas-monthly-tourism-revenue-up-3-5-pct-in-october-2026-290181/
